raw: Agent Name: Planner, Step Number: 7, Reason for Mistake: The Planner accepted an auto-generated DuckDuckGo snippet claiming George II’s mother was Countess Palatine Christiane Henriette of Zweibrücken-Birkenfeld, ignoring the reliable Wikipedia snippet on the same page stating his mother was Princess Augusta (Auguste) of Schwarzburg-Sondershausen. By not opening and verifying the source, the Planner misidentified George II’s mother and thus gave the wrong paternal grandmother.
